questions.text: Which sentence uses COMMAS correctly in a list?
options: We grew corn, beans and squash on our farm.
We grew corn beans and squash on our farm.
We grew corn, beans, and squash on our farm.
We grew, corn, beans, and squash on our farm.
questions.answer: We grew corn, beans, and squash on our farm.

questions.text: Which sentence uses an APOSTROPHE correctly to show possession?
options: The farms fence was broken.
The farm's fence was broken.
The farms' fence was broken.
The farm fence's was broken.
questions.answer: The farm's fence was broken.

questions.text: Which is the best TOPIC SENTENCE for a paragraph about why water conservation is important on farms?
options: Farmers use water every day.
Water is wet and important.
Conserving water on farms is essential because water is a limited resource that all crops need to survive.
Some farms have rivers nearby.
questions.answer: Conserving water on farms is essential because water is a limited resource that all crops need to survive.

questions.text: Which detail BEST supports the topic 'Goats are useful farm animals'?
options: Goats have four legs.
Goats can provide milk, meat, and fiber for clothing.
Goats are found on many farms.
Goats sometimes escape from their pens.
questions.answer: Goats can provide milk, meat, and fiber for clothing.

questions.text: Which sentence is the BEST concluding sentence for a paragraph about the importance of bees?
options: Bees are insects.
Some people are afraid of bees.
Without bees to pollinate plants, much of our food supply would disappear.
Bees live in hives.
questions.answer: Without bees to pollinate plants, much of our food supply would disappear.

questions.text: Which sentence is written in CORRECT past tense?
options: Yesterday, she feeds the horses.
Yesterday, she will feed the horses.
Yesterday, she fed the horses.
Yesterday, she feeding the horses.
questions.answer: Yesterday, she fed the horses.

questions.text: Which sentence uses CORRECT subject-verb agreement?
options: The horses runs across the field.
The horses run across the field.
The horses is running across the field.
The horse run across the field.
questions.answer: The horses run across the field.

questions.text: Which word correctly COMPLETES this sentence? 'The rancher and ___ horses rode through the gate.'
options: him
their
his
them
questions.answer: his

questions.text: Revise this sentence to make it more SPECIFIC: 'The dog ran across the field.'
options: The animal went somewhere fast.
The big dog ran.
The old border collie raced across the sunlit wheat field.
The dog went fast there.
questions.answer: The old border collie raced across the sunlit wheat field.

questions.text: Which transition word BEST shows CONTRAST?
options: first
therefore
however
additionally
questions.answer: however

questions.text: Which transition word BEST shows CAUSE AND EFFECT?
options: but
also
therefore
next
questions.answer: therefore

questions.text: Which sentence uses correct CAPITALIZATION?
options: My Family moved to texas in the Summer.
My family moved to Texas in the summer.
my family moved to Texas in the summer.
My family moved to texas in the summer.
questions.answer: My family moved to Texas in the summer.

questions.text: In EXPOSITORY writing, the writer's main goal is to ___
options: entertain the reader with a made-up story
express personal feelings about a topic
explain or inform the reader about a topic using facts
persuade the reader to take an action
questions.answer: explain or inform the reader about a topic using facts

questions.text: In PERSUASIVE writing, the writer's main goal is to ___
options: explain facts clearly
convince the reader to agree with their opinion
describe a personal experience
tell a fictional story
questions.answer: convince the reader to agree with their opinion

questions.text: Which sentence contains an ERROR?
options: The chickens laid three eggs this morning.
Her and I fed the calves before breakfast.
We planted seeds in the garden yesterday.
The old tractor needs a new engine.
questions.answer: Her and I fed the calves before breakfast.

questions.text: What does it mean to REVISE a piece of writing?
options: Check it for spelling errors only
Rewrite it from the beginning
Improve the content, organization, and word choice
Add punctuation marks
questions.answer: Improve the content, organization, and word choice

questions.text: What does it mean to EDIT a piece of writing?
options: Change the main topic
Add more paragraphs
Fix errors in grammar, spelling, and punctuation
Make it longer
questions.answer: Fix errors in grammar, spelling, and punctuation

questions.text: Which sentence uses a COMPARATIVE adjective correctly?
options: This watermelon is more bigger than that one.
This watermelon is bigger than that one.
This watermelon is most bigger than that one.
This watermelon is the bigger in the patch.
questions.answer: This watermelon is bigger than that one.

questions.text: Which sentence uses a SUPERLATIVE adjective correctly?
options: That is the most tallest tree on the ranch.
That is the taller tree on the ranch.
That is the tallest tree on the ranch.
That is more tallest tree on the ranch.
questions.answer: That is the tallest tree on the ranch.

questions.text: Which sentence uses quotation marks CORRECTLY?
options: "I need to check on the horses, said Grandpa."
I need to check on the horses," said Grandpa.
"I need to check on the horses," said Grandpa.
I need to check on the horses, said "Grandpa."
questions.answer: "I need to check on the horses," said Grandpa.
